notes: Teferi, Timeless Voyager [-8]: 'Each creature target opponent controls phases out. Until the end of your next turn, they can't phase in.' The Ogre phased out under seat 1's control would phase in during seat 1's next untap step (CR 702.26a), but that step comes before the end of seat 0's next turn, so it stays out. The second sentence compiles to PREVENT_EFFECT(PhasingEvent(phased_in=True), IS_RESULT, DurationUntilEndOfNextTurn), which the phasing step consults. Was tools/scenarios/known_bugs/ (BACKLOG B-75, divergence D16) while the sentence compiled to a ZoneChangeEvent no phasing produces.
